renderContract.technique: Opaque matte flat color fields, usually 3-4 major planes per material
renderContract.geometry: Keep exact current collision polygons, support edges, destruction units, slope threshold, coordinates and field extents. Decorative facets clipped inside original polygons.
renderContract.contact: Subtle light cap only on actual supported upper edges of at most 70 degrees; no cap on a false platform.
renderContract.semantics: Shared gameplay identifiers across themes: identical destructible palette/cracks/destruction-boundary treatment, identical reflector surface/edge/ticks, consistent direction, polarity and ON/OFF symbols. Theme adjustments must preserve these identifiers.
renderContract.details: Screen-pixel edge widths; remove small decorative detail when zoomed out. Preserve essential state symbols.
renderContract.background: Retain the approved background art unchanged. Select ordinary component materials and palettes from the theme setting; match the flat matte rendering grammar while keeping foreground boundaries legible.

themeSpecific: An independent material palette selected for each setting
Nonfunctional mounts, foundations and supporting material
shared: Destructible material palette and crack marks
Reflective plate and contact-edge palette and surface symbols
Gameplay state, direction and polarity symbols
palettePolicy.integrationRule: Shared functional components may attach to themed supporting materials. Do not recolor shared gameplay identifiers to match background hues. Resolve legibility with separation, spacing and outline support; no new gameplay or collision changes.
